purpose: Owner-approved face-only co-founder cartoon portraits for local About page

portraitPrompts.name: melih
portraitPrompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: FACE-ONLY cartoon avatar, passport-photo framing, for a co-founder profile card.
Use the supplied photograph as an identity reference only. Create a clearly HAND-DRAWN COLOR CARTOON portrait of that same recognizable adult man: clean confident dark outlines, simplified sculpted hair shapes, carefully designed beard shapes, warm flat colors with a few soft cel-shaded planes, expressive but proportionate eyes. A polished editorial cartoon character avatar, not a photo filter, not an airbrushed photo, not a realistic 3D digital human. No photographic skin or hair texture.
FRAMING IS CRITICAL: Only the complete head, ears, and a tiny short section of neck. Frame from the top of the hair to just below the chin. No torso, no chest, no arms, no hands, no full body, no shoulders. A very small collar sliver at the absolute bottom is acceptable. Centered square avatar, straight-on passport-style view, upright level head, friendly natural smile, 8% breathing room around the entire hairstyle.
Preserve the distinctive identity through the face silhouette, brow shape, real eye spacing, nose and smile shape, hairstyle and facial-hair silhouette. Keep these as clearly recognizable cartoon interpretations of the reference person, not a generic substitute face. Keep him adult.
Genuine transparent background. No environment, no props, no circle or frame drawn in the image, no text or watermark.
MELIH: elongated oval face, broad swept wavy black hair, thick arched dark eyebrows, brown eyes, full dark beard with well-defined cheek silhouette and a distinct moustache, open smile showing upper teeth. If a tiny collar sliver appears at the bottom it is navy blue. FACE ONLY passport avatar, render all features as a designed drawn cartoon.
